name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir sentences a gazed player for a hostile cast, free ones too, not for a buff
contract: The Menacing Gaze (2118423) tooltip: 'any active hostile action will force his hand. Active actions are all
spell and ability casts that require a power source and are on the global cooldown.' A buff or heal is not
hostile: Arcane Intellect (1459) on the hero leaves the gaze in place. Fire Blast (2136) on Mandokir is
hostile, costs mana and triggers the GCD; cast free under Clearcasting (12536) it still Sentences the caster to
Die (2118424). The round 6 script skipped casts whose paid cost was 0, so free damaging casts went unpunished
(tester, round 7: damaging spells on Mandokir 'didn't get decapitated sometimes'). Mandokir gazes his only
enemy 15 s into the fight and turns it into Menacing Gaze 4 s later; the hero stands in melee and does not

steps.label: Let the transfer finish
CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
Engage Mandokir
CONTROL: Mandokir fights
CONTROL: Mandokir stares at the hero with Threatening Gaze 15 s into the fight
CONTROL: 4 s later the stare turns into Menacing Gaze
CONTROL: the gaze alone does not sentence the hero
The gazed hero casts Arcane Intellect on the hero
CONTROL: Arcane Intellect landed
Arcane Intellect recalculates the hero's stats; restore the test health
Give a wrong sentence time to land and let the GCD end
DISCRIMINATING: a buff is not a hostile action and sentences no one
CONTROL: the hero survived Mandokir's swings
CONTROL: the Menacing Gaze is still on the hero
The hero gains Clearcasting
CONTROL: under Clearcasting Fire Blast costs no mana
The gazed hero casts a free Fire Blast on Mandokir
CONTROL: the free Fire Blast hit Mandokir
DISCRIMINATING: a free hostile cast Sentences the hero to Die
CONTROL: the sentence consumed the Menacing Gaze
